content: {"like":["Amazing and wonderful acting performances from Christopher Walz, Dicaprio, and Sam Jackson (his finest acting role).","The first 2 hours are well done, clever, and emotionally engaging."],"dislike":["Tarantino’s use of modern hip hop, rap, and 2015 music in a film set in 1858.","The soundtrack being a cheap exploit to sell a soundtrack.","The character Sam Jackson’s portrayal being loyal to his former slave master in a way that seems off and misguided.","The last 45 minutes being ugly, violent, poorly acted, hastily written, and unsatisfying.","Tarantino’s poor acting performance with a terrible Australian accent."]}
